name: PhiFlow
role: Python grid-based smoke and fluid simulator, stepped in a loop so fields save per frame
summary: Python library (PhiFlow with the phiml backend layer) for grid-based 2D and 3D smoke and incompressible flow, also particles. You write the time loop (advect, add buoyancy, project) and read fields as arrays, so frames can be saved for a scene to render. NumPy runs on CPU; PyTorch, JAX and TensorFlow are optional.
use_when: Smoke, ink or flow-field motion baked from Python as per-frame arrays, where splishsplash particles do not fit
Small 2D grid simulations on the NumPy backend, with no GPU and a deterministic rerun
avoid_when: Particle liquids and surface meshes: splishsplash
Conserved-mass or exact-volume claims: the advection schemes are not conservative

install.macos: python3 -m venv venv && venv/bin/pip install phiflow==3.4.0

notes: 2026-11-27: lead said uv pip install; plain pip in a venv works. The NumPy backend pulls in scipy and matplotlib; no torch or jax needed.
2026-11-27: lead version 3.4.0 (2025-08-02) confirmed on PyPI, MIT; it is still the latest release, so maintenance rests on repository commits not checked here.
2026-11-27: a fully closed box fails in make_incompressible with Diverged on the singular pressure solve; leave one side open. scipy SparseEfficiencyWarning prints each step.

assessment.rationale: PyPI 3.4.0 uploaded 2025-08-02 (over 12 months), MIT per PyPI metadata; lead reports repository pushes in 2026, not verified here. Nothing catalogued does grid smoke or 2D flow from Python; splishsplash is SPH particles.

evidence.result: Partial: 8 of 9 predeclared checks pass. 64x64 buoyant smoke, 60 fixed steps, NumPy backend, Python 3.12.2: SHA-256 of 4 saved frames identical across processes, max divergence 1.6e-6, centroid rises 18.9 cells after inflow. Fails: mass drift after inflow under 2 percent (mass 94.8 to 103.3, range 14.4 percent).
evidence.scope: NumPy backend only, 2D smoke, macOS arm64; determinism, divergence-free projection and frame saving pass; mass is not conserved (non-conservative advection); no other backends, 3D or rendering.
